nodes.title: Note: Pika H3 Flex
widgets_values:
## Pika H3 Flex - 6-Step Scenes From Pictures

Directed scenes with native audio in 6 steps. Pika's adapter on the MiniMax H3 reference model, plus:
- **VSA gate** (FastVideo team, ComfyUI port by Kablex): the speed trick, 75% sparsity
- **Semantic Bridge** (speach1sdef178): optional, its own group. The author lists reference workflows as not supported in v1 and warns about reference-audio lip sync. In my sitcom test the picture looked better with it and the sound was better without it.

**Two switch boxes**
- **Reference Mode**: on for one to three reference pictures. **Reference 1, 2, 3**: turn on one group per picture. In your prompt, call them Image 1, 2, 3.
- **First Frame Mode** + **First Frame Picture**: use these instead of Reference Mode to start from a picture. Keep only one mode on.
- **Semantic Bridge** (Bridge and Spectrum box): on or off. On looked better in my test, off sounded better.

**Seed:** change noise_seed on the main node for a new take.

**Prompt tips**
- One clip, one location, one small story. Cut between clips.
- Say positions as they appear on screen: left of the frame, not her left.
- Write the result of every action. Invented objects need a reference picture.

**Settings inside the subgraph (keep them):** sampler lcm, Pika's 6 manual sigmas, CFG 1. Keep the memory cleanup nodes on.

**Measured on an RTX A4500 (20 GB), 1056x608, gate on, sampling time:** 5 s 1:43, 15 s about 7:00. At 1344x768, 15 s with references ran out of memory on 20 GB and finished on a 24 GB card.

Use PyTorch built for CUDA 13 (cu130) with driver 580+. Video by TheLocalLab: youtube.com/@TheLocalLab

nodes.title: Note: Size Settings Reference
widgets_values:
| megapixels | 2:3 portrait | 16:9 landscape |
|---|---|---|
| 0.4 | 544 x 800 | 864 x 480 |
| 0.6 | 640 x 960 | 1056 x 608 |
| 0.8 | 736 x 1120 | 1216 x 672 |
| 1.0 | 832 x 1248 | 1376 x 768 |
| 1.2 | 928 x 1376 | 1504 x 832 |

**VRAM, RTX A4500 (20 GB), one reference, gate on.** 12 and 16 GB are caps on this card, a simulation, not real smaller cards.
- 0.6 MP, 5 s: stayed inside both caps, same speed.
- 0.6 MP, 15 s: finished, but peaked at about 17 GB, past both caps. On 12 or 16 GB, start with short clips.
- 0.8 MP, 15 s: ran out of memory on 20 GB.
- 1344x768, 15 s, three references: ran out of memory on 20 GB, finished on 24 GB.
Output (multiple=32). The RTX Video Super Resolution node doubles the final size.

nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**Base H3 models** - https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main
- minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors (~21 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
  - optional smaller: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_w6a8.safetensors (~16 GB, same speed, similar quality)
- qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors (~16 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
- minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/vae/

**Pika H3 Flex adapter** (Pika Labs) - https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/loras
- pika_h3_flex_ref2va_v1_bf16.safetensors (~2 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/loras/
- MiniMax H3 Community License: read it before commercial use.

**FastVideo VSA gate** - https://huggingface.co/barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo/tree/main
- fasth3_vsa_gate.safetensors (~3.9 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/loras/

**Semantic Bridge adapter** (speach1sdef178) - https://huggingface.co/speach1sdef178/MiniMax-H3-Semantic-Bridge/tree/main
- MiniMaxH3_SemanticBridge_v1.safetensors (~11 MB) -> ComfyUI/models/semantic_bridge/ (create the folder)

**Semantic Bridge custom node**: search MiniMax H3 Semantic Bridge in ComfyUI Manager, install, restart. The adapter file still goes in ComfyUI/models/semantic_bridge/.

Other nodes (Ref2VA VSA by Kablex, Memory Cleanup, Nvidia RTX Nodes, KJNodes, rgthree, VideoHelperSuite): install with ComfyUI Manager -> Install Missing Custom Nodes.

widgets_values: A 5-second product shot of the chunky amber-glass perfume bottle from Image 1 (exact same square shape, faceted brass cap and amber liquid, no label), resting on crushed ice in the crystal dish on the dark emerald marble bar. One continuous shot, normal real-time speed. A slow, low dolly glides across the marble toward the bottle as cold white vapour drifts past it and light rolls through the amber liquid, settling on the framing of Image 1. No people or hands. Sound: quiet upscale cocktail-bar ambience, ice settling, a slow jazz double-bass. No text, titles, logos or voiceover.
